Training-Time Drift for Generative Modeling
Carol White, Dan Brown
arXiv, 2026
Abstract: We replace inference-time iterations with a training-time drift field,
reaching one-step generation while keeping the distributional target.
Drifting moves the iterative process from inference to training.
A single forward pass matches the pushforward distribution.
References
[1] Smith, A., Jones, B. (2026). Flow Matching for Language Generation. Journal of
Synthetic Tests. https://doi.org/10.1234/flowlm.2026
